It Stores and organizes media, you can search for photos with keywords, you can make minor tweaks and edits, but don't expect to be able to get Photoshop features out of it.

author: A Google user
review: I love knowing every time I'm in a trusted wifi area, my photos are being preserved. Even being in the computer industry, I have lost photos. Since I started using this app (I have not lost any), I have upgraded phones and not lost anything. Plus, with the newer generation phones, other than optical zoom, they rival my camera for quality. So the photos are worthy of preserving. Almost 3 years later, and it is even more amazing than it started out.

author: Tony Ricketts
review: I have really liked the app, so far! The auto-animations, collages, and filters are generally pretty good. And honestly, I wouldn't end up making them myself... So for Google to make them for me is great. Collecting images by face is great, too. Even for pets! I just wish I was better at getting old photos included in the app so it could go through those as well.

author: A Google user
review: Love, love, love this app! So many great features! You can easily group photos together by people, places, things, selfies, etc. Makes it so much easier to find that photo that you're looking for. And you can even make a photo book! I plan on using this in the very near future with Mother's Day and Father's Day coming up. It doesn't have to be a commercial holiday to make one. It's great for scrapbooking, organizing your photos, and various edits.

author: A Google user
review: Honestly, I'm impressed with the app. The main reason I downloaded it was for the backup and flexibility of that feature. The stylized photos the app creates are amazing. And the panoramas I've had created form 7 photos are flawless. You cannot tell that it's not one photo. Impressive! As far as printing an image is concerned, I imagine if you can share to a printer, it should work. Aside from that, I could not find a print function, but I do not have a printer driver & printer installed.

author: A Google user
review: I love how Google photos organizes your photos. You can tell it to recognize a face as someone and then next time you type that person's name in the search bar it pulls up all the photos. It also works to put a word or two in a photos info then next time you can search that word(s) to pull up that photo. It also makes really good suggestions, like archiving old photos. And it makes sharing photos SO easy. It even allows people to make comments on the album/photos. 10/10 would recommend!

author: A Google user
review: The options are out of this world. You can set your camera to infinite gradations of raw, JPG, HRD+ etc settings. The app actually teaches even seasoned photographers more finely honed skills all the time. And it still allows you to revert to purely manual control. I wish I had this years ago, when I developed an interest in photography when my kids were little. You look at old photos from negatives and you cry. The dark sky option is an unbelievable bonus.

author: A Google user
review: I love it because one, it automatically backs up my photos, and as someone who has lost photos before because of a device breaking down or corrupting, this means the world to me. Then two, I love being able to search for specific things whether it be people, pets, objects, or other things. It's saved me so much headaches I could've had like when searching for things I need as reference for something at work because it recognizes practically anything in a picture.

author: A Google user
review: Google Photos has been my go-to for everything we document in our lives. The program is very intuitive. It will convert your best memories into albums, animations, videos and more. The technology will even archive old photos or screenshots, with your permission of course! Program works with most third party websites to upload and order prints as well. Cant say enough!

author: Melissa C.
review: This app will back up every picture on your sd card as soon as the picture/video is taken. But it will not delete them off card. You have to manually do it. If you have lost photos check the apps archive or trash folder. The app didn't lose them. You did. If it's slow to up load your photos than your phone provider sucks and or so does the wifi. Every setting is in the app settings. Take a tour of it first, before you start pointing. My only complaint is I can't title my movies anymore.

author: Evander Odoli
review: Google Photos is a game-changer! The app's AI-powered organization and search features make it ridiculously easy to find and relive my favorite memories. I love how it automatically backs up my photos and videos, so I never have to worry about losing them. The search function is incredibly intuitive, and I can even find specific people, places, or things in my photos. The sharing features are also super convenient. 🤩

author: Lisa Culhane
review: I love how Google Photos organizes photos not only by date, but by face (recognition), and how it offers logical suggestions that I usually accept. For instance, I receive suggestions for photos that I might want to rotate or archive. The editing features are straightforward which makes them easy to use. Overall, it helps me to easily organize and search for photos.

author: Jane Appleton
review: I use Google photos everyday and find the editing tools useful. I love the prompts to review old photos and suggestions for improving pictures. It's a great app that I wouldn't want to be without. I'm not worried about the recent cap on free storage. I back up all my photos and videos to my PC and an external hard drive. All the cap means, when I finally reach the limit, is that I won't be able to view all my pictures on my phone... or at least not without paying, which I'm unlikely to do.

author: hana qalesya
review: Gallery is an essential app for storing and organizing photos and videos. It allows me to keep my memories safe and easily accessible anytime. The app is simple to use, with features like albums, search options, and editing tools. I like how everything is arranged neatly, making it easy to find specific pictures. Overall, Gallery is practical and important

author: A Google user
review: Love this app! I make sure to hook up my phone whenever I get a new one. It has saved so many great memories when my old phones have died suddenly and I haven't been able to get them off of the old phone. Plus if I want to put an old photo back on my phone for whatever reason I can. All it makes great suggestions for animations and other things. LOVE it!

author: A Google user
review: Fantastic search function for people and objects. I now rely on this app to store & find my photos from my phone & all messages. So great to then quickly & easily view photos on my laptop. I have bought Chrome book because Google apps work so well together. 2019 - the search function is not so reliable recently - it doesn't recognise English (UK) words.

author: A Google user
review: Amazing app! I use Google Photos over my phone's stock gallery app. Love being able to back up my photos. I enjoy using the search bar to find what I need. (via phrase or person or place etc). I like being reminded of old photos/ events cause I'm sentimental. My only complaint is not being able to back up individual photos in a folder... Like I don't want to back up ALL my SCREENSHOTS (which are usually junk memes) to the cloud... just 1 or 2.

CONS: ORGANIZATION & MISSING PHOTOS. Should be good, but it's bad at 
organization. I would have prefered it over other apps if it was better at 
sorting photos. I'd like to have Facebook as a separate folder from Camera, 
for example. Even worse, some photos i take that are still present on the 
sd card disappear suddenly. Please solve these, and I will go back to 
google photos.

author: A Google user
review: Hands-down the best gallery app on the Play store. It has all the features a gallery needs and it couples as your personal photo editor/assistant. The suggestions it makes are accurate and fun. Backing up the photos to the cloud is another big plus. That means you can never lose your photos no matter what. Lastly, the space management is phenomenal and it works like a charm, freeing up space that's not needed, archiving old photos and deleting photos that have already been back up.

author: Jenna Clarahan
review: Its great not having to worry about my phone running out of space any more. All my photos are stored worry free without any effort. Also, the search functions are very helpful. It makes it easy to find a photo from 4 years ago that randomly came up in conversation in less than 30 seconds usually. No endless scrolling trying to find stuff. The only thing is I wish I could post directly to Instagram from photos. Its annoying having to download the photo and then post it.

author: Kenneth Anderson
review: I love how it backs up all my photos and then I can delete all old pictures in the gallery to make room for new pictures or videos. The new feature that have been upgraded to fixing any problems with color brightness or darkness in the pictures is perfect for me cause sometimes I forget to adjust the lighting in the background causing accidental pictures taking in not enough or too much light and also I'm liking how I have options of keeping or deleting duplicates of photos in data space.

author: Reaghan Buckels
review: My trusty go to app for all my photos to backup to, so I never lose a precious moment! It's super easy to find a photo your looking for with it's search features, like grouping photos by location, things, people (each different face it recognizes you can name who that person is making it that much easier!) Plus they give you sooo much free storage space! They make you collages and show you memories which are always nice on gloomy days!

author: Maor Smud (maoroh93)
review: Been using Photos for a while now. The amount of stuff you can do with it is staggering. The power their A.I has is truly awesome and the fact you don't have to worry about order is just so nice. Want to find a photo? Search for a word and you get anything with that word in it. Teach it what faces it sees and it'll aggregate all the photos those faces appear in. As a young man, I show this to any old person that asks me to organize their device storage: "just back it all up to photos!"

author: A Google user
review: Google Photos is just incredible for how much it does and how unobtrusive it is. Not only does it back up all pictures automatically, but there's also a bunch of photo editing features that the app sometimes applies to pictures to incredible results. I took two separate pictures that Photos stitched together, which is already pretty cool, but what blew my mind was that I couldn't find the seam between the two of them to save my life. I'm very impressed with this app.

author: Ezio Auditore
review: I love it so far, simple and easy to navigate. And auto collage is really cool, using AI to sort different things and people, i can search photos by word. Also features called "Memories" bring back nostalgic old photos beautifully. The free 15 gb is suffice but i hope there's more free storage or the storage is different from Google account storage. It would be perfect haha..

author: A Google user
review: If it was possible to give 10 stars, I would be giving 10 stars. This makes scrapbooks, animations based on your photos, perfectly placed where they were taken and puts it into albums that make it easily searchable for you. I use this app every single day! Saves all old photos so if I lose my phone, all of them are safe and stored for me. Life saver and a blessing!!

author: A Google user
review: This is a great app. I love it. So easy to use. It automatically edits our photos and makes animations. It also makes awesome videos including photos and videos of a day. I love it very much. Bt the face grouping needs improvement. Hey Google please release an update where you can directly give name to the person while viewing the photo. I cannot find photos of some of my friends in the grouped section. So please do something

author: susan Lynn
review: Everything turned out awesome! Love the way categorized!!! The quality of the pictures were wonderful. Easy to find what I'm looking for. Wonderful awesome wonderful delightful couldn't ask for more. I love it it doesn't forget a single picture when I can't find one somewhere else I can always depend on looking there it takes great pictures! You can make them big or smaller whatever size you want I love my pictures! Everything I'm looking for is right at my fingerprints you couldn't ask for

author: Kiki Kyurkchieva
review: Great little app! Can be set-up to backup all photos on the device on which it is installed, and will provide 'memories' (old photos or collections) as a slide show on the anniversary on which they were taken. The app also features a Favourites category for easy access of photos which are used on a regular basis, as well as an archive which stores document-type photos. The app seamlessly syncs across devices and the user can backup the photo gallery of multiple devices simultaneously.

author: Norman Nuthu
review: Google Photos is an absolute game-changer! It effortlessly organizes my entire photo library, freeing up precious storage space on my device. The AI-powered search feature is mind-blowing, allowing me to find specific photos with just a few keywords. Plus, the auto-generated collages and animations add a fun touch to my memories. Thank you, Google, for this incredible app! 📸🌟

author: Bethany Abbott
review: If you are even reading the reviews, you are wasting time. Do you take a lot of photos? Here's an app that will change your life for the better. I have so many albums on here, I can find a photo from 5 years ago in 5 seconds. It might take a bit of time to back up all of your photos, but you'll never lose them again. Back up time has also significantly decreased. It's so easy and convenient. Do yourself the favor and download.

author: Emad Steitieh
review: I love this app. It saved my important photos I took with the many phones I lost, damaged or failed something in them. I thought I lost these photos forever. Suddenly Google Photos comes back to me with old photos for my children and family, important occasions and friends. Awesome, Awesome, Awesome. The 5 star is the least. It was lovely to see my children when they were too young. Thank you Google.

author: A Google user
review: Just keeps getting better. I love this photo app for storing and sharing photos. I'm not on social media so it a fun experience to share my albums with friends and family where they can like and comment on photos or the album. I also use the photo scan option and have been transferring old photos into my album. I love being able to make informational notes on photos for context. Super excited about the locked photo folder! Anyways, love this app!

author: Mitch Yancey
review: I really like storing old photos on here, in case of a disaster, you at least have a back up. Photos are precious memories! On this app I would like photo "flip" for selfies. Also when adding photos, and I change the date on the photo to add it to a certain year, it doesn't go to that year. I spend more time dragging photos to drop them in the right date after uploading.

author: A Google user
review: The incremental improvements are excellent. Please add mote granular control over how photos are deleted, added and where. I really just want to dump some old photos into Google photos, delete it from my hard drive and it is still in Google Photos as well as the Google Photo folder on My Drive. [Edit - Ok so just using the Google Photos website instead if the Back & Sync app achieves this, minor hassle] Ps. Yes your are tired of hearing this, but please bring Picassa back from the grave.

author: A Google user
review: Super easy to use. easy to share, edit, and create albums. I made an album of my son in about 30 seconds. great people, place, and thing recognition software. you can search for items in your photos and it will return accurate results. I needed to find a photo of my truck, so I searched 'truck' and the app provided me with all the photos I had of my truck.

author: A Google user
review: Very good app for storing pictures and videos. It is also a great help during travels where you and your friends can create a shared album and just share all your pictures together so you can post real time if you want. Plus upon downloading the app, I found old photos here because I didn't know I still have back up of pictures I had from my previous phones. It also has that feature that creates stylized edit on your pictures and creates animations for consecutive shots. Overall, great app!

author: Holly Shanahan
review: I honestly love this app. So handy to have!!!! I wish there was a feature however to scan for duplicate photos, because everytime i redownload an old photo, my Google photos uploads it again as a new photo, and have ended up with multiple copies of the same photos. Either way I love this. Being able to always have my photos from multiple devices, sharing albums instead of sending them over etc. So useful

author: A Google user
review: Google photos is a fantastic program which functions well across both personal and professional photography roles. There's lots of easy editing options and RAW capable. Link sharing is an excellent way to distribute or share content with clients. The keyword search function is a huge time saver especially for those folks with extensive photo libraries. It's pretty universally compatible, I use it across phones, tablets, and laptops with no issues what do ever. I highly recommend Google photos.

author: A Google user
review: wow...just deleted a video that was really important, i went hunting to find if there was a way to get it back, ended up on Utube but it didn't work for me I couldn't find the app mentioned to download, went on the photo icon on my phone where you can now organise and archive clutter and bingo, got my video back. absolutely excellent, well done Google.

author: Kristie Macleod
review: I've used Google Photos for years and have almost 5 thousand photos there. I have many options to choose from when making reels or videos and have had some made for me in the photos app. The best feature is the Photo Books where you can order a hard cover book that are photos you select, also soft covers. A great gift , better than an album of old photos you select the best and you can buy a hard cover book for home or gift. Love the app!

author: Natalia Villafane
review: I've been using this app since 2016, don't regret it. It's great because you can free up your phones space by having you pictures backed up. Another great thing is you can have everything back in your phone by downloading it again. It's great for email back ups and google docs or sheets. By having things backed up you can access them in any device just with you google account. And the search engine are great to find specific thing you can search by facial recognition, or by date it's great .

author: Ahther Zaheer
review: Great app but after the recent updates, whenever I edit my photos the app keeps crashing. I hope you fix that issue and add more useful features. Maybe you can add a much better portrait photo option than whatever we have now. Note: Hey guys, after the recent update I couldn't find an option to reduce my pictures (Portrait blur) amount. So, put your magic there too.

author: Daniel Short
review: Photos always look FANTASTIC in Google Photos. It never tries to cut corners and show you lower resolution pictures because it's easier, now it shows you the real thing as it's supposed to look. I want use any other app to view my pictures. The only thing I can think of is the fact that finding videos taken from other services, such as Mobizen for one example. I just uploaded the video into Google Photos. And I cannot find it anywhere.

author: A Google user
review: I've personally never had ANY problems w/ it! I LUV it actually!!! It's so easy to navigate through, and it's nice to go back when i have free time, and j just look up old photos, and the collages, and slide shows that they automatically make for you is pretty awesome too, especially cause you get to decide if you want to keep them or not.

author: A Google user
review: For what it's worth, what makes this app different from.othwr apps is the Google Assistant and Google's machine learning algorithms running in the backend for you. I no longer have to sort or categorise photos, keyword searches are more than capable. The timeline based navigation is also another feature. Really love the way we can zoom in and out of a photo collection.

author: A Google user
review: I've been using Google photos for 4.5 years and it has never let me down. The photos stay organized, you can edit them with enhanced features, and there is so much storage. I love that I can find my photos in my drive and the photos app. I use everything Google, so I highly recommend using this.

author: A Google user
review: Best photo app out there, unlimited storage with decent quality (it would be perfect if they increased the video quality to 4k60, but that's fine tho). Assistant does a great job creating short movies, collages, etc. Albuns organized by people via face detection is great when you wanna search for a photo of someone specifically. Couldn't recommend more.

author: A Google user
review: Never been so suprised...! And just so happy...! All at the same time!!! I've just recovered hundreds of photos I had backed up using a phone that I later lost in December last year!!! I've now decided to scan all my old photos that are safely kept in the family albums, and back them up in the google photos' free 15GB cloud drive. I LOVE THIS APP! Strongly recommend it to one&all. Thanks Google.

author: Yves R
review: Google photo helps to upload to cloud on its own and helps clear up photo space on my phone which helps alot when I realized I have no more space while traveling. It is very handy when you take a lot of photos and videos with your phone. It also has memories features on the top of the page when you open the app, and it will show you old photos from each year, and of a variety of stuffs such as vacation or food etc. it's very good as it makes me look back and see the good memories.

author: A Google user
review: Keeps all my photos organized and I love theres a search bar. I've gotten a new phone a couple times in the past few years and all my old pictures and new pictures I take are there! Also it will occasionally take pictures and put them into a fun collage or animate them or use a stylizing tool that makes the original picture super vibrate and gorgeous while keeping the original photo!

author: A Google user
review: safety is a the best way to get ahold of your old photos from the times you had a good time or even them not to good times 🤔 You have a opportunity to get photos from your college or even if you want to build a photo book of awesome and beautiful pictures, just to look at for them times when your day just not going well for you .Yes,it may cost you a little bit but wants the price you can put to a smile on your face.I can almost guarantee you will not regret to build you a book.

author: Tarsha Coleman
review: Great app, have a Google phone and integrated well. So easy to share high quality photos with other Google photo users. Love the shared albums me and friends use them when we go on holidays or adventures so we can share pictures easily. Like the automatic creations as often editing is v good. Easy to search for photos through the person identification! And cool that you can name the person so you can just search the name of the person.

author: Sarah Youssef
review: Always got precious memories saved so even if you lose your phone, change it, etc your photos and videos are still safely saved. Super easy to use, you can even make your own home video from a collage of photos and videos in your library. You can even organize photos based on a specific person's face, making it easier to find specific photos. Sharing and sending photos and videos is pretty easy as well.

author: Helena Adetutu Falade
review: This app is so underrated. It is the best record keeper i have ever seen. No unnecessary ads and its back up is really amazing. Makes it easy to search for photos and videos even when you don't remember the actual date or month, you can just search based on year. While you search per year, it stills lays it out per months on each year. In a nut shell, it's super awesome.

author: A Google user
review: there are so many things I love about this app. It makes it easier to access old photos I no longer have on my phone. It also provides frequent reminders of happy past moments , create collages and edits photos with a nice touch. But my favorite part about it, is the fact it recognizes faces and groups the pictures of each individual together. You can even name the face and the next time you type their name in search bar, you will get all of the pictures they appear in. Simply brilliant!!

author: Anirban Banik
review: This is an wonderful app without any second thought. But the recent update is bothering me cause I can't find photos automatic creation of stylised, animation, collage from the backed up pictures. Previously it was easy but now it seems there is no tab for that. Its all coming random on the recent highlights. Please solve it.

author: natural magic
review: LOVE THIS APP. I have literally thousands of photographs (seriously, over 30,000) in this app. Google Photos happily takes care of one of the most precious things you have -- your memories. I recommend taking photos of your most precious photographs, backside too if there's writing on it. If there is a fire or some other catastrophe (heaven forbid!), you don't have to run around frantically looking for a photo album before running out the door. Think about that!

author: A Google user
review: Love this app. One feature that is a serious drawback is that if you delete a photo from Google photos, it deletes it from your device as well and vice versa. I understand the idea of backup and sync but to not have the option on a photo to photo basis seems ludicrous to me! When I've wanted to clean up my phone and open up some memory locally, I have actually lost photos not remembering this bizarre feature. That a backup is no longer backed up but rather deleted. Come on Google!

author: Elbert Jones Jr
review: I don't know how but it's good to see some of my old photos from my old phone that maybe saved up in the cloud appear on my Google photos. I have no quite a few albums at a good price. I just wish that they can add a feature to LinkedIn videos that's been taken. And although I got the six before the seven came out by the way the little longer I would have to seven with her the photos are immaculately beautiful.

author: Sandra Williams
review: Sharing - Super easy and quick sharing between iOS (Apple) and Android users by clicking a link - NO "must have account or app" nonsense. You can have a shared album that both users can add to as long as they have a Google account. Sorting - The layout is very comprehensive and makes massive amounts of photos easy to navigate and enjoy. Search - I almost never have to scroll through all my photos; I can almost always find my photo by searching place, time, people, objects, date, colors, etc.

author: Rick T
review: Simply the best. I don't 500 characters are enough to say about this app so I'll make it short. Not only easy great for organizing my photos and easy to share, it fixes my photos, automatically creates panorama pictures from individual pictures I took, automatically creates collage from related photos. The feature I like the most is it often shows me old pictures so I can relive the moment.

author: ADV Parth Sarthy
review: It's a real great app, simply the best.. but there should be an option to add faces when the app can't recognise them in the photos, this is a major issue I've faced, and that when I search for,say screen records, or downloads, or WhatsApp photos, videos, at times it so happens that it's there, uploaded, but it doesn't show in the search results.

author: A Google user
review: All these new ideas and ways of looking at my pictures are great but...... Why can't I also see my picture albums the way I have them saved and sorted by albums that I have named them. Another great feature would be if I could tell the app to not show certain folders that I don't want to show.... like the folder with my music. All my album covers show and I have to scan thru hundreds of album covers when looking for a picture. It's maddening. I used to have an app named JustPictures that did let you block any folder you wanted but it seems to have just disappeared.

author: Danny Robinson
review: I have used Google for quite a long time, and then discovered photos over decade ago. Marking cloud services as suspicious until proven otherwise Ive found google more reliable than drives, and now my whole collection is accessable which means I use and show off photos more. Since then I have enjoyed its suggestions, rotations, collages, slideshow movies. My camera gets more use and shots are easy to find by time, people, cats, dogs, location, colour, theme or object. private search for photos

author: Rose B.
review: I love being able to use 'Search' tool engine and finally find a photo I've been looking for. It helps tremendously, and it's one of those convenient but considerably "life-saving" tools that save time instead of having to literally scroll back through thousands of photos after forgetting date/time and/or location a photo was taken.. and what makes using Google Photos even better..? You'll find all of your storage automatically backed-up in a safe place. Haven't had any privacy concerns so far

author: A Google user
review: If you dont have this app yet get it. Free unlimitied storage of your photos (compressed) but not enough that it matters for most people even if you plan on prinint 4 x 6 photos. Easily organize and share you photos with friends and family. Seamless back up from your camera roll or any other folder on your phone like screen shots. Lastly the facial recognition is amazing so finding old photos are easy if you know the person in the photo. You no longer have to scroll 2 years down your library.

author: Bernard Emis
review: Google Photos is an excellent app for storing, organizing, and backing up my photos. The automatic backup feature ensures I never lose important memories, and the search function makes it easy to find specific pictures. I also love the editing tools and AI-generated albums. Highly recommended for anyone who wants a hassle-free way to manage their photos!

author: Joseph Croskey II
review: Like the photos it creates! 2/4/25 Super responsive! Fixed immediately. I'm not only one missing that feature. Not used to it yet, AI not super accurate 4 me. 2/3/25 Just reduced my rating because the search feature changed. Previously, You could add a label to a photo, and then search for that photo based on the label you added. Now the new AI search feature doesn't read those labels. Consequently, I can't find all of the photos that I had previously labeled.

metadata.replyText: Hi Joseph. The Library has been replaced by the Collections view. Learn more: https://goo.gle/46IVLQA. Also, we’ve heard your feedback and have updated Search. Please update the app to the latest version. If you’re still having issues, please send in-app feedback adding “#search”: goo.gle/4ewu28p.

author: A Google user
review: One of the best photos app, just drives home the superiority of Google and the android eco system. I have an IPad and hate the apple cloud combo which is already full and complaining about storage. Had no such problems with Google and android in the 8 years I have been using it. all my photos are on this app in high quality and I can search for a old photo so easily. Search for "(Name of Person) and Eagle and our bird santuray photos are in front of me. Love it!!

author: Richard Bosworth
review: Having decided finally to upload our photos to Google this app really is fantastic at letting one browse ones history in a simple and delightful way. Viewing old photos of the kids, and the automatic albums are brilliant. It feels like a lot of care and thought has gone into to app, it is a truly wonderful experience. I wonder why Photos finds faces in the photos of people born before the subject. Isn't this fundamentally easy to filter.

author: A Google user
review: I've used google photos for years. It's great to have the peace of mind that you're not going to lose your photos at any given moment. Upgrading phones is a lot easier since the pictures/videos aren't directly on my phone but on my google account. I enjoy scrolling through all of my old pictures on occasion and it's great to have them organized and all in the same place!

author: Marion Lacosse
review: I love this app. The search feature is fantastic. I can search for images that I know happened in certain months (like birthday parties or when my kids were newborns) but nothing more specific and it shows me them. I was looking for a picture of a fancy armoire that I had taken who knows when and tried 'cabinet' and it brought it right up. My grandma asked me if I had a recipe of hers that she couldn't find. I'd taken a photo of it years ago and searched 'cocoa'. App found it immediately.

author: A Google user
review: Google photos is a fantastic program which functions well across both personal and professional photography roles. Link sharing is an excellent way to distribute or share content with clients. The keyword search function is a huge time saver especially for those folks with extensive photo libraries. It's pretty universally compatible, I use it across phones, tablets, and laptops with no issues what do ever. I highly recommend Google photos.

author: Asrul Husen
review: The best way to keep my memories safe! I honestly can’t live without this app. The automatic backup feature is a lifesaver, so I never have to worry about losing my photos if I lose my phone. The facial recognition and search function are mind-blowing—I can find a photo from 5 years ago just by searching for "dog" or "beach." It’s organized, fast, and reliable.

author: A Google user
review: the latest version sucks, shows that uploading is only limited to wifi, but when connected doesn't even upload🤯 didn't expect this, however the old photos are still present so out of nowhere 2*s my suggestion don't update, the last version was far better. Trust me for once, it'll save ur asx. Edit: Sorry I was wrong the app works fine. Pls update😄

author: Tom
review: The best photo organizer there is, hands down. Also editing options are really good, though professionals might have an extra app for that. I really enjoy this app, being able to find old photos quickly by referencing a person, a name, a location, a time frame or even a quick search for 'christmas'.

author: Richard Kleeman
review: In one word. Awesome! Best photo app that I've used I'm leary of change, but I suppose this old dog needs to learn a few new tricks. This app helped retrieve 1000's of lost photos, dating back to 2013 It will take me some time to figure it all out. Very easy to use, even for a beginner.

author: A Google user
review: This is a great app. It helps you organize your photos, create cool collages, add animation and now we can upload photos from old photographs removing the glare making them look like they were taken with a digital camera. Google photos is an awesome way to keep all your memories together safely in the cloud. Google is now allowing unlimited storage space! Wooo hooo

author: jesijames anderson sparks allie
review: Old photos seem to disappear...,. I still have alot of photos that I'm trying to find , but i do enjoy putting together albums, as well as being able to see my pics grouped by people, places ext. That does assist in finding the location of alot of my favorite pics.

author: Yuan Kristoffe Lajom
review: For me, this is one of the best gallery apps you can use! You can delete some old photos and videos in the old gallery, if you back them up in this gallery app. It also doesn't affect the storage of my phone! As a result, this is a very worth-it app that you can storage and back up pictures and videos in case of low memory...

author: Benjamin Holloway (OK_BigBen_OK)
review: I love this app again. So many great features. And the Ai search is working better. This used to be my favorite app. The recent update removes the shared folder access on the landing page. Now I can't find the shared folders. Response to dev: yes, but it's not the same. There's even still room at the top for the old shared album icon to go right back where it was.

metadata.replyText: Hi Benjamin. You can now find shared albums in the Collections view. Learn more: https://goo.gle/46IVLQA. Also, feel free to share feedback with us here: https://goo.gle/3gaHLEz.

author: Eiowow Yap
review: Just thank you for this WONDERFUL APP!!! I get to look back memories in the past. Pictures that I have forgotten but bring back wonderful memories of places, travels, people and connections. I also like the feature that you get to compare old photo of my son a few years back and present. Make me realize how fast time flies.

author: Marie Ange Mukagahima
review: I truely like memories and pictures organisation. But may be if possible make it easier to find a picture to put on watsap status .. Because it is difficult to put a picture on watsap from storage due to the way requires to search a picture in one folder. So if it is may be from over one month picture, it require a realy painful search

author: Kathleen Espersen
review: It's just a great app. Never any issues. So I've heard people cannot find their pen/marker tool to write on a photo. One guy wrote it was lost in updates. It's not in tools anymore. You can find it in "Markup". Just keep swiping left under the edit settings and you'll find it. This app is always improving 😊.

author: J Philli
review: What a bonus...even reminds me of events and photos from the past. Will these photos be around 100 years from now? JP 9/24/19 What a bonus...even reminds me of events and photos from the past. Will these photos be around 100 years from now? JP 9/24/19 Update: It is now 10/9/20 Ever since I added an SD card and tried to move my local photos to it, directories changed. When texting that app can't find a lot of photos I have just taken. I also wonder about the Android OS and memory management.

author: Robert Noble
review: I LOVE this app. I use it multiple times a day. It's such a convenient way to find old pictures or videos of certain people or places or things. I esp love to make birthday cards for people that show old picture memories with them. I don't know how I lived before I found this app! Seriously, every picture you've ever taken all at your finger tips.

author: Carmen Martinez
review: Google photos is the best. With the google photos app I never lost a photo. It's the best app you can back up your photos on. I recommend it as well as all other google apps. I really enjoy when Google brings up old photos from years past. It makes me happy to see those memories. It also brings up non family photos that I don't want to keep so I could delete them. It creates collages and short videos which you can choose to keep and share. Thank you Google!

author: Dylan Verdun Sullivan
review: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I use Google Photos for everything — backups, organising memories, and storing all my food and travel shots. Syncing across my devices is really smooth, and search makes it easy to find old photos fast. It would be great to have a few more advanced editing tools included, but overall it’s reliable and keeps all my photos safe. One of my most-used apps.

author: A Google user
review: Of course it's the absolute best. No more lost photos when changing devices, no more running out of space on mobile phones, no more fears whether the external drive that you stored the photos from 2003 will work. Doesn't duplicate photos, unlimited space. Decent editor, assistant is great. Could go on and on.

author: Wahyu Nugroho
review: Great apps to save your photos without worrying to lose it when you switch to new device. It can store unlimited photos with decent quality. But to bad they end the unlimited storage soon. I like the way it reminds us about old photos we took 1, 2, 3 years ago.

author: Miss Mac
review: I read only negative reviews about this app but I have nothing bad to say about it. I have hundreds of pictures and tons of videos. The app remains me to clean up my cloud by deleting duplicate and poor pics, the app automatically uploads my pics and if it's nit synced for some reason I can quickly and easily upload them with one click! I love this app it creates albums and collages and brings up old pictures I forgot about to suggest new albums to share!

author: Obiye Peace
review: I absolutely love this app. I really dont have to worry about losing my photos once theyre deleted. My only problem is making movie creations. Not sure what im doing wrong but whenever i use a song from my phone for and edited video it wont save. And i also think being able to search for photos without internet connectivity would be nice, doesnt seem possible though.

author: len cabs
review: It's so great apps from the start I use this, I'll never disappointed. Because the old pictures I deleted so many years ago I still see there and laugh to remember that time, how I look in years ago and in the present.. However they have some issues for backup side that u need to work it so it will not returning again and again. But still have a problem all you have to do is fix some error.. Over all I give 5 🌟 stars

author: A Google user
review: Absolutely amazing. I've been using Google Photos for about 7 years now and I've never had an issue. Not one lost photo/video or issue with backing anything up. Also, the people on the Google Photos Team do this awesome thing where they make animations, compilation vidoes and randomly bring up the stuff you have stored to show you years later. I lovr this app and will continue to use it.

author: A Google user
review: Easy-to-use photo app that doesn't suck up resources or bombard you with ads. It's also helped in a pinch when I've needed to find a photo or an album in a hurry. I'm pretty picky when it comes to installing apps, but Google Photos is a must-have for me. I highly recommend it.

author: Ira Gershenhorn
review: So incredibly confusing. Switched phones. Now it won't back up. I'm searching on the internet for an answer. What a p i t a! I use this app for the auto backup (never have to connect the phone) and I take advantage of the automated panoramas. I sometimes shoot a sequence of photos knowing that the AI engine will make a pano of it. I occasionally like the 'improved" photos. Cannot find settings.

author: A Google user
review: i absolutely love this app! ive used it for years on all kinds of devices, including my iPhone & love love love!! i have such good pictures from years ago saved that will always be saved and easily accessible because I always use this app. I completely love it and it makes saving old photos easier, without having to worry about switching your photos to new device.

author: A Google user
review: Awesome app. I love how you get extra storage in the cloud which makes it easy if you're switching from phone to phone. The other cool thing about this app is that it automatically pulls up old photos from years prior and especially someone like myself who has a young child to be able to relive those moments all over again is pretty awesome.

author: John G
review: Easily the best photo app out there!! I don't need to back up my photos when I change phones, I don't have to dig deep looking for a photo taken 3 years ago, it's all backed up & sorted out professionally by Google! I just type the location where the photo was taken or choose from a list of faces & Google finds it! Amazing app.

author: April Ellenburg
review: I enjoy being able to find my pictures with a quick search. It would take me so long to scroll through to find a picture from way back in the day when my 18 year old was a baby. Recently he passed & I had to get together photos of him, I searched a place or his name & up they all popped. Very convenient, definitely when in this situation & you have absolutely no patience to do an extensive search job. Google Photos has made trying times tremendously less difficult . Thanks Google Photos!

author: A Google user
review: Busy parents dream app!! It automatically backs up photos, detects who people are so I can search for photos of specific people, detects location for grouping photos for albums, automatically makes albums (trip the to the zoo becomes an automatic album), and it makes it really easy tip order fairly priced photo albums. Love this app!

author: A Google user
review: rapid synchronisation across devices. Easy browsing by date. best with good network connection - images take a second for sharp resolution. search by subject very useful - if you get the search term right! For scanned old photos create an album with the year in the title and search for the album. Scans are dated by the scan date so eg scan of 1980s pic looks like it was in 2016!

author: A Google user
review: Love the added security of having all of my photos automatically backed up to the cloud. I would be devastated if I lost photos of my child. It organizes photos by the date and even does a "look back at this date a year ago" which is really nice. I can also share access to my photos with people of my choosing.

author: A Google user
review: Loved the app Best app to store your memory... Here are my few sincere suggestions... 1) plz make the shortcut edits like rotating the photos without going into the main edit page... 2) Plz add the machine learned folders (*specially for the old photos, like a month ago n older) which will store the similar and same moment in it with the editable description of the moment. It got really difficult to find a photo when you have thousands of photos... This might help it out. 3) the assistant suggestion for every photo... Like a best edit or the straightening of photos, etc. Btw the app is great in its kind...!!!

author: Stephen Crook
review: Actually just works. Until it asked me to rate the app, I didn't even think about this as an external piece of software. If I were to pick something to complain about it would be how long it takes me to gain access to my old photos when I replace a broken phone. I honestly thought I had lost some photos and then a few days later I had them again.

author: A Google user
review: Best app I ever used . When looking for a photo all I have to do I open the app and look at all the photos and dates. To make sure you always have all your new pix you should back up and update every few days or longer , all depends on the use of storage and backup . If you use the app properly you can get great use out of it.... google photos also takes your best pix and turns them into a professional collage and also has animated features to the pictures or album Google photo gets 100%...

author: Alessandro “Augustus” Galietto
review: I must like it because its the main app. that I have used for the last few years since I stopped getting I•phones and moved through the Galaxies. Its okay it dose the job of storing my thausands of pictures videos screenshots ect. It has some neet fitures like bringing up old photos reminding you of what you were doing on this day so many years ago, pretty basic standard stuff for a photo app, the storage dose cost money on a monthly subscription but it relatively cheap starting at $1.99 4 100Gb

author: Franklin Robinson
review: Sometimes ( very rarely) I have photos that self delete without my consent. I haven't lost anything vital yet but it's still an issue and the only thing preventing a five star review. Edit: went back through and I'm missing photos that I really wanted of my partner and I did not delete them. This needs to be fixed. Edit: apparently the issue was resolved and all is well

author: Kazimierz
review: Best cloud backup option for photos available. Old photos and videos load instantly (for me), suggested edits can be nice, and I the memories feature has gotten really good, something I look forward to seeing each day. And there is finally a world map!!

author: Joy Mitchel
review: Great app. It saves my memories automatically in a very organised way and allows me to be able to access them and look back years after they've been taken. I love that it organises every person in the pictures by facial recognition so that I can open the search bar and easily find a pictures of anyone at anytime!

author: A Google user
review: Really good app for photos and photo storage as well as editing the photos taken. Never had a problem with the app and updates make it constantly better. I cannot find a single thing to say negative about it. Will use untill someone proves there is a better app for photography. Not that it can't get better which I look forward to, but it's already the best pic app running in my opinion.

author: Amery Booth
review: I love google photos!! I love looking at all my memories and old photos being able to share them with whoever i want and also have them share theirs back with me. I love tbe suggestions, how it makes animations and collages out of my photos and allows me to make my own... very awesome app. Definitely one i couldnt live without!

author: MTJ4 ATT&J11
review: I do have some difficulty depending on what device I'm using some pictures show up sometimes and sometimes they don't. Some even show black. I'm just happy when it works. But when it doesn't it very disappointing. My biggest thing is being able to locate my pictures all the time whenever I click on the app especially the old pictures

author: A Google user
review: Great app, well organized, and i love the rediscover this day feature, its fun to look back on old photos from years past. You can create all sorts of albums and collages and it automatically can detect different people and group the photos that way. This is just an overall amazing app.

author: Katherine Casey Hetke
review: I really like this app and how its setup although I can't find my pictures very easy and some of them seem to disappear this is been added on November 14th I noticed that I have alot of duplicate photos that is taking up a lot of my space I know I didn't purposely have duplicate photos! I will investigate further or manually get rid of those but I still give you a 5-star rating because it's an excellent photo app!

author: Sterben Steven (ᚷᚱᛁᛗᛗ.)
review: Google photos is so much more than a storage location. The ability to search for people, places, And other things that you haven't actually identified but Google AI does makes it so valuable. Recently I wanted to find a picture of myself and my wife sitting in front of some tulips about 5 years ago. So I just typed that description in and found it in 2 minutes. That's the kind of thing you can do in Google photos that you can't do in a standard storage environment.

author: Emily Redka (Emily)
review: Bless this app, it's great and out performs several other photo apps. You can search for photos with keywords and it can identify it in certain photos. You can search "cats" and it will find all your photos of cats. It can also recognize people and places. Very good and efficient.

author: Elizabeth Aboona
review: "I love Google Photos" (12-11-15 my last review of this app) & w/ this last update it forced me to come back & Review hoping someone will hear me. I'm not happy w/ the new photo editing, I use this feature if not only daily but hourly. I use it to not only scan old pictures, but docs. & the distorted cropping was very helpful, made my photos look professional, then there were the filters, they may not have been the best filters, but the filters were good enough for what I needed. Please fix!

author: Christina Collins
review: Google photos has been keep my photos for literally the past decade which has been so vogal for me. Getting to make sure I have my kids photos from the time they were born to now has been amazing. I lost many phone not to mention broken phones yet to each new phone id log into my credentials to find my pictures. I love the photo stories that it designs for me to view even if I decide not to purchase. It gives the user the choice rather than feeling like you were forced into buying it. It's a yes

author: Fewik
review: Useful to find specific photos taken in a certain place or with a particular person or even pet, can edit photos, although basic editing it's more than enough for many, easy to create new folders and move photos, easy to navigate through, no bugs or crashes ever encountered, splits photos from different apps into seporate folders, options to create animations, collages and movies, types of photo or video can be filtered easily such as a cinematic photo. Nothing negative

author: Craig Hopkins
review: Google photos is my favorite app. Rather than play on social media I go to Google photos and and manipulate share and take pictures that I can download later. It comes complete with a complete editing functions. They make my pictures look good although touching them up sometimes feels a little like cheating. It helped me get some decent pictures of old pictures that were in a photo album from the 70s and was able to reprint them on canvas. Boy was I impressed

author: A Google user
review: Who doesn't love the features and ease of Google Photos? I download and delete apps regularly; not because I no longer need them but because they fail to meet my app needs. These same apps also fail to evolve and improve. Not Google and Google Photos. You can't find a more comprehensive photo app available. You also won't find one more stable. Don't think, download!

author: A Google user
review: I love Google photos so much it saves a lot of Heartache when you realize that you can't find older photos this automatically allows photos to be thrown directly in as soon as you snap the picture I love you Google photos please never change they could allow a little bit more free space but I think that there's so much I don't know nothing about megabytes and stuff like that so I know I was in using it for years and I've never had to purchase any additional storage it's awesome best out there

author: Kristin Howell
review: I really like the editing abilities. I have literally taken old photos barely visible to recognizable. It would be great to have these tools AND the tools that come with those beauty apps together in one. Make it dirt cheap or free and you'd have a real winner. This app is really good though.

author: Scott Fucci-Twiss
review: This is by far my favorite app for photos. I love that it can recognize faces and pets and create seperate albums. I love the search function, makes it so simple to find an old picture. Free photo backup is great, especially since I can use it cross platform.

author: Erik Minges
review: Love the recommendations and ease of use. Makes organizing photos so much easier, even tho it's still a chore to do it. Also being able to buy canvas and photos in app is awesome. Shipping fees are a bit high and you cant bundle canvas / photos in the same shipment (at least I couldn't find that option).

author: A Google user
review: This is a great app. The only complaint i would have is more access to editing movies, or the ability to add to the assistants creation. What "IT"creates can spawn inspiration, and it would be nice to expand on the 26 second movie. Having said that, GREAT APP!! Additionally, just discovered the editor once on google photos is Snapseed. For those who want the old photo editor back, download snapseed.

author: A Google user
review: Love, love, love this app! It makes storing and finding photos so convenient. It segregates photos based on faces, places, events, dates, etc. It shows memories and creates collages, colour pops as well as videos and gifs on it's own. It helps delete cache photos. I can find 5yr old photos in a moment thanks to this app. Must have!

author: Turgil Green Resort
review: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Google Photos is a fantastic tool for managing and backing up my photos. The automatic organization by albums and the face recognition features are super helpful! I love how easy it is to search for old pictures just by typing in a place or keyword. Plus, the automatic enhancements and collages it makes are a nice touch. Overall, it’s been a reliable, intuitive, and convenient photo storage and sharing app!

author: A Google user
review: I love this app ... it's like a backup photo album.. and I love how it makes videos, collages, photo/video animations on it's own from photos/ videos that was taken.. love the people/face recognition feature on this app... instead of looking through a ton a photos to find a picture you can type in the person's name and it'll bring up all the photos with that person in it... I love it... there's options for creating photo books as well ....

author: A Google user
review: I love how organized my photos are in this app! It's very easy to find a picture by using the search bar or sort your photos into different albums. I really like that it tells me I can clear up memory by moving some photos and deleting some that are doubles. AMAZING PHOTO APP!!

author: A Google user
review: Update: yes it sucks that unlimited uploads is going away on June 1st, 2021. Maybe existing users could've been grandfathered at unlimited and set limits for new users going forward. ------ Even for a newly updated service, it is great, and the updates make the app better. There are many photo backup solutions, but few are unlimited, and including videos, and fewer have such a robust way to search and organize old photos. Highly recommended.

author: A Google user
review: I am surprised at how Google gives back for free. I like: • Is very light weight. • Sorts pictures very well. • Makes everything searchable. • Provides useful photo edit suggestions. • Gives me a sense of security to my privacy. • Makes photos accessible via multiple devices. • Unlimited photo storage with no noticeable photo quality reduction. • Ran out of space to write. I just cannot find flaws to mention here. I really love your products and what you do; please never join the dark side :)

author: A Google user
review: it does everything, tells you when your photos are rotated, archives old photos full of text, knows whos who in the photos, its almost like a real person is going through your photos! its a bit creepy at times not gonna lie but its really convinient despite the fact that google is probably selling the photos and other information to advertisers.

author: A Google user
review: This is a great app for organizing and backing up my photos. The search function is outstanding and I've been able to find lots of old photos easily. The app works well to share photos easily too. And when you backup off your phone, you can free up space.

author: A Google user
review: We love using Google Photos to share pictures of our little one with friends and family! The shared albums feature makes sure that everyone is up to date with the latest cute photos. I also really enjoy the assistant, which makes it easy to search for photos by person, place, or activity. Finding photos of my dog has never been easier. This is hands down the best photo gallery app available on either Android or iPhone. Do yourself a favor and make this your primary photos app!

author: Stacy Escobedo
review: Constant innovation. This app has gotten better and better over the years. The auto sync with my phone camera made me start using it. Now I look forward to seeing my "1/2/3/etc. years ago" photo feed. The search capabilities also keep improving, making it so easy to locate old photos.

author: A Google user
review: Amazing app, must have cause it keeps back ups of your precious photos and memory. There is no comparison of a great photo back up and also assists in reminding you of your old photos plus gets to make some interesting photo slide videos and compilations of some wonderful memories from different days. Must have app

author: A Google user
review: This is amazing backup for your photos! The SD card on my phone corrupted and I lost several years of photos. I was heartbroken! A few days later I discovered that I had previously downloaded Google Photos on my phone and it had been backing up all along! You can't even imagine how thrilled I was! I found ALL my lost photos!

author: Ishmanpreet kaur.
review: It's the best app, as i don't have much pictures jn my phone but it provides extra storage. The second most important and fabulous thing about it is that it helps me to find the pictures by face and also it stores all the good and old pictures. So it becomes easy to upload from google photos whenever there is birthday of someone.

author: MWB Teach
review: 94. I get reminders of past events through memories. 95. The app suggests photo enhancements intelligently. 96. I can create movies from selected photos. 97. The app identifies and groups similar faces. 98. I can search for photos by the objects in them. 99. The app recognizes landmarks in my travel photos. 100. I can create photo books directly from the app. 🌐 *Integration with Other Services* 101. Syncs well with Google Drive. 102. I can insert photos into Google Docs easily.

author: Gopal Mahalik
review: Google Photos has been amazing for backing up my old photos! I was able to upload and organize years’ worth of memories with ease. The automatic backup, search features, and facial recognition make it simple to find specific moments. I feel relieved knowing my precious memories are safely stored in the cloud. Highly recommended for anyone wanting a reliable photo backup solution!

author: A Google user
review: Great app I love the way it organizes your photos and the assistant is great at doing collages or gifs. The only thing I don't know is why the assistant only uses the latest photos to create new things excluding the old photos... but I really love this app. It would be great if they give you a little bit more storage for free 2 years later I still love it!

author: jorge rico
review: Love the stability of this built-in app. It's ability to just take the pictures or snapshot a part of a picture even your own and save and forget. Searching for old pictures is getting easier and more and more features are been added as time goes by. Excellent photos I take with my Samsung Galaxy Note10 Plus phone. I never use a real camera anymore to take 90% of my pictures.

author: Imran Hossain Chowdhury
review: Google Photos is an amazing app for storing and organizing pictures and videos. The automatic backup feature is very reliable, and the search option makes finding old photos super easy. I love the smart albums, memories, and editing tools. It keeps my memories safe and well organized. Highly recommended!

author: A Google user
review: Love the fact it backs up my Gallery! The Assistant is so cool at creating albums, and photos like the 'Then&Now.' If you can't find a certain picture of someone just ID that person, and it'll dramatically increase your chances in finding that special photo!

author: A Google user
review: I love it.. Helps to find my old photos.. Old memories..it store my memories.. while we change our phone backup helps me.. it save all of my photos n I'm damn happy with it.. I'm thankful for google for this photos.. and may be there are some mistakes with it.. but i look after the useful once.. it sometimes saves my time in searching pic.. & i simply love it!!!

author: Mandy Hernandez
review: It helps you to chronicle your life without the added stress of adding yet another task to your "things to do list". All your images in a single place...with face recognition, easy calendar to help you find specific pictures...and of course the reminders of the day which take you back down memory lane.

author: A Google user
review: I need help to retrieve my missing photos. I had backup in cloud, appears i lost everything without permission to anyone. Its a sad day that others dont ask anymore to share, seems just to take and destroy. Thats the heights of BULLYISM, i am the type that this display will not go unrewarded. I had to change my previous instrument because of there actions

author: Jo Knox
review: I updated after Devs contacted me, it seems better, the order of photos are now recent to older, they were older to recent right at the bottom, which would be a problem with many photos. I can't find where the settings are for choosing order ascending or descending or by date etc, but the last update now has the recently taken photos at the top, ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

metadata.replyText: Hi there. We're sorry to hear you're having trouble. We hope we helped.

author: A Google user
review: When I try and save photos created by assistant to library, I can't find them anywhere. Google suggestions don't work. Not diggin' it. Edit... I really do appreciate having my photos saved and accessable. I enjoy this very much.

author: A Google user
review: I love the assistant. It automatically suggests stylized photos, creates panoramas when I pan a view with several photos. It reads my mind. Reminds me of past events with collages of old photos. It even sugests photo books. It's pretty awesome!

author: Roadhog Harley and put up wet
review: This has been one app I know I can count on !Yes you can use it like a storage locker it'll let you make scrapbooks if that's where you're at . It will send you old photos that you've forgotten about memories it'll let you reshare them just like you did the first time.

author: A Google user
review: I love this app, so much space to store my pics and share with my closest friends and family. I've recently recommended this to others because they was having difficulty with their phones memory. They were super pleased to find that photos don't have to be saved on memory cards and internal storage anymore but can be accessed anywhere there's Internet connection available. Happy User here.

author: Kimberli Heino (Kimmerjo)
review: I think this service and the photo quality it produces is just marvelous!! I'm particularly grateful that even my old photos look really good, both onscreen and on paper. There's a studio photograph of my grandfather taken in the early 1920's, one hundred years ago, that came out looking clear and focused. I'm very impressed!

author: A Google user
review: I love how Google reminds me of old photos/ experiences I had forgotten about. It allows me to relive the joys of those moments. ❤ I also appreciate that it backs up precious photos, so that I am still able to see photos I once took with phones that I don't even have anymore.

author: A Google user
review: best app ever! they have some many options to cross utilize other editing apps in conjunction with this app as well as a categorized filing search for you to find specific photos very easily! now if they would just add the ability to take the actual pictures, I'd be in heaven!

author: K F
review: I love having google photos to keep a safe backup of all my cherished photos! Easy to use and easy to find my pictures later. I love being able to make albums which also makes coming back to find my pictures easier too. I couldn't do without google photos, to me it's a must have application.

author: A Google user
review: Great search features but missing some basic sorting options. Can't find the option to just sort through only videos. Also the auto awesome movie editor is extremely downgraded from the previous version. Typical Google... 3 steps forward, 4 steps back.

author: Sidra Ameer
review: I love this app, I can find my pictures now immediately or in no time. So I'll give five stars. I can easily find pictures of my friends and all the pictures at one place. The only issue I have found is that sometimes it mixes the pictures of one person with the other with face resemblance.

author: Jerry Perkins
review: Just downgraded my rating from 5 stars to 1 star. It was much easier to navigate before the current update. I can't find the album's I had created. Photos aren't divided up by location/catagory automatically (or I can't find them if they are). This update seems to have simplified the app by removing all the features that made it more than just a place to find your pictures.

author: A Google user
review: What can I say? It's the best of its kind. The storage space, the quality back ups across all of your devices, the memory feature of old photos where you can see how thin or fat you used to be a year ago. I mean it's really a decent app and worth downloading.😁

author: A Google user
review: I really like it, because it keeps photos from other apps too. Photos from other people are also in there, so I can just find a photo sent in a chat room in Photos. It also recognises faces, so if I want to find a photo with a specific person, it is very easy. But sometimes, the date of a picture is wrong.

author: ROBERT W. PINO
review: Just love this app, but I wished that they would send out a search party for my missing photos, I thought facel recenation would find me pretty easy but to date I have had to go to my many Facebook accounts that were mine to get back almost 5,000.oo missing photos of me and my family and the one or two friends I have.

author: Hon Ayodele Adedeji-Campbell (Ilosiwaju)
review: The App is excellent! Perfectly organising my pictures and giving me easy access to old pictures taken far back 2015. Now I don't have to be panicking losing any form of pictures. They are well arranged and collated section by section for easy accesibility Thank to Google Pictures! The experience has been awesome! Ilosiwaju!

author: A Google user
review: It's basicly all you need to organize your many photos in your phone and beyond. I keep all my share ready photos here, and it has many clever and helpful features, like reminding old photos, shared album with family (with face recognition) it makes sharing photos with a group easily.

author: Kess
review: love it, but I have lost photos because they didn't get backed up, when I thought they did. it was a bunch of my son, which I cant get those memories back and they were a lot of firsts for him, first Halloween, first Thanksgiving, first Christmas, I'm still devastated 😥 it is my own fault, I had it set to only download pictures when on WiFi I don't have wifi so operator error. 😬 overall 5 stars, I love when I go wheeling and get pictures the app makes a story with them, love it 💚

author: A Google user
review: I love it! I have thousands of photos backed up all the way from 2013! This is perfect for me because I have 2 kids and don't want to lose my photos when changing phones. i can always redownload old photos with a new phone. I also love the videos and animations the app creates for me.

author: Vishal Lohiya
review: This app is best app for me considering uploading unlimited high quality photos and videos. Have few interesting ideas like photos of the same day few years back and search feature is amazing. Few shortcomings: Sometimes face recognition is not correct, but there is no way to correct it. Sometimes location in story is captured from map, but not allowed to edit exact place name. In old photos from camera if date is not properly setup, then all photos are listed under wrong date, currently no ways to update i

author: Billy “William” Sargent
review: Everything works satisfactorily, trimming and using the automatic feature to improve the image. But I especially like being able to colorize black and white photos. That's wicked nifty! 7/4/24 WHAT HAPPENED TO THE COLORIZE B&W PHOTOS FEATURE?! That was terrific that was nifty. This week I can't find it.

author: Laura Jones-McDowell
review: Sometimes. It'll change format on me just when I need something urgently, then I cannot find the photo. Additionally, I don't know without consulting a younger person, lol, how to retrieve archived photos!! Aaagrh!!!! Can someone please make that easier for seniors? TY! It's not good for me because I don't know where my photos are and I panic. Don't trust that I won't lose them.

author: Tricia Price
review: This app is so cool & helpful! I am editing my review because for some reason I can't find my pictures after 2019! I know I'm a airhead some times but if someone could explain how to access my photos & where they are being stored I would greatly appreciate it.

author: A Google user
review: This app is very useful for reminders and updates on your schedules. I almost lost my stuff in storage. I couldn't find the pictures with my stuff inside. But luckily, I had to look on the specific date on when I took the pictures. So I found my pictures!!

author: Mariah “Riah” Tarness
review: Love it would be nice to have a green screen as an option with holiday, beach, moutians, city, desert as the background as some of us can't afford the programs for a green screen let alone a green screen also love how I never have to worry I'll always find my pictures would be nice to if (say you upgraded your phone) your pictures go back to the date taken not downloaded in the library just some great updates advice I would like to see

author: A Google user
review: Google photos is the best application so far in storing pictures and videos,Its hastle free and easy to use,no matter one has bought a new phone or have lost the recent one,it gets all the old photos and memories back in just few minutes,i've been using it since 2012 and i am still very much fond of it

author: Joey Chesnut
review: I love Google Photos. It has kept the last almost DECADE of my life via photos stored away safely for my family and me. I can easily search for photos by typing in the exacr date if I can remember it or just the month and year and easily find what I'm looking for. It backs up my photos hourly so I don't have to and I have never been let down by it doing so for me. Great app. Highly reccomend it to everyone I know.

author: A Google user
review: I love this app because it stores all my photos and you can easily download the app and login when you get a new phone and has all the photos there. As well as the little animations and movies they make automatically because it brings up old pictures which is really nostalgic.🤠

author: A Google user
review: I Love this app! I can keep all my photos together, free up space in my phone, enjoy the collages and movies that the app makes for you. It's so easy to find a photo, just by simply doing a search. There's so many extras. Five Stars ✓✓✓✓✓

author: A Google user
review: Most of the times it's good to use and search option to find photos is really helpful. When having multiple accounts and sharing photos is what becomes hard few times but can figure it out with a little bit of search. I loved the automatic color pop and videos from old photos.

author: Joleen Robinson
review: I never have to worry about losing my photos, and I always get highlights. It's great to see what happened one year ago or four. And then it finds photos similar and makes a slide show... like it did tonight of all the sunset pictures iv taken. Can't find fault, touch wood 😆

author: A Google user
review: If it weren't for Google Photos (and fb) , I wouldn't have access to any photos I've taken. I've had to access my old photos for various different reasons and it is so easy and convenient to have that capability from my phone. It has literally saved me time and time again.

author: A Google user
review: Great app. Love the assistant which surfaces old photos etc. Really need more options for music and ability to change photos that assistant brings up. Sometime they great but you want to change a single photo . More advanced options for album management and archive management also needed.

author: Ra'monto Ligons
review: I have had Google photos for over a decade now, I love how the app can recognize faces and create stories, animations and colleagues. I had to switch phones over 4 times it's great to know that your old photos and videos are safe and secure. Definitely one of the top 3 best photo app out there!

author: A Google user
review: Lets you upload photos (unlimited storage if you pick high resolution vs original [be honest, are you a photographer?]) and lets you search for photos (even recognizing faces and objects adding keywords you may not have put in; scary feature but I'm cool with it)

author: A Google user
review: I love this app. It sorts through your photos and recognizes faces, so you can find specific pictures of loved ones. It creates albums, collages, and stylizes pictures for you. You can create shared albums with your friends, where you both contribute pictures, so it's easy to share photos. It's just a well designed app.

author: A Google user
review: Awesome 👍. The features are great and the storage is amazing. I love that it creates albums when I travel or when I attend an event without me asking it to. It makes motion and collage pictures for me, which is great. It separates images baswd on different criterias which makes it easy to find my pictures. I love it!

author: Victoria Grant
review: I carry photos with me. Phones with an SD Card slot are very important to me. I like to carry my music and my photos/memories. Having a space where I can back up old photos, free up device space and access my memories any time for me, in my opinion, is a wonderful!

author: A Google user
review: love this app! it's so amazing being able to find specific pictures of my friends so easy with Google photos. I love that it automatically will separate pictures and create folders based on who is in the picture. it creates folders with each person's picture in their own album! making it super easy to find things! it's so smart it will even make a folder 4 ur pets! I never have to worry about losing pica ever again because each one is automatically backed up after its taken! love it!!!!

author: Mirosław Kaczmarek
review: Deleting 3 stars now. 2-3 app updates every week. Seems getting worse every time. Most recent update made total mess with timeline. Newest photos disappeared somewhere. author: Christopher Huertas

author: Drew Woods
review: Alright Google, it's a solid app. But here's the deal, we've become accustomed to this behaviour where my photos are backed up. Now that this will take up my limited amount of free space, I'm FORCED to pay OR not use the service. Well I'm not paying. Plain and simple. I have my own personal cloud storage device. I just happen to like your UI a bit better. Plus the AI is better. BUT, I pay for Amazon Prime. They offer free storage for my photos now. Sooooo, you're really losing access to ALL of my new photos, and not gaining anything from me. I'd highly recommend you reconsider this decision. In the very least, allow for a CERTAIN amount of space BEFORE it adds on to your storage. Like, allow 100 free full size photos a month. That's 3 photos a day roughly. That's fair. And wouldn't take up TOO much space. I'd be a bit more conscious about what I'm backing up and whatnot, but that's fine. I tend to just take a bunch of burst shots and save them all but I only really need the best one. Anyway, that's all. You are now just an archive of old photos. Unless there is a free storage option, I won't be uploading any photos to this. Thank you.

review: My Pixel 6 suddenly restarted out of nowhere and Google Photos started to duplicate all my photos and theeen it started to backup the duplicates !!! metadata.replyText: Hi Mkrtchyan. When you create an album on Google Photos, a copy of the file is created, but it will not consume storage. If you delete the photo from the album, it will remain in your Google Photos account. If the photo is deleted, it will be deleted everywhere. Also, take a look at this article: goo.gle/37eSSXM to fix problem with the app. Thanks.
